content.overview: Section 93 is omitted and does not impose a current annual-return duty. It previously addressed returns concerning changes in promoters' and top shareholders' holdings. Current significant-beneficial-ownership reporting is governed by section 90 and its rules.

content.study: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 93 (Omitted). Section 93, which previously required a listed company to file a return of changes in promoters' and top ten shareholders' holdings, was omitted by section 24 of the Companies (Amendment) Act, 2017, brought into force on 13 June 2018. Do not treat the former section 93 duty as a current filing requirement. Current significant-beneficial-ownership declarations and reporting are governed by section 90 and the Companies (Significant Beneficial Owners) Rules, 2018, as amended. This record documents the omitted provision; it does not claim a live statutory duty.
